name: José Hernández
bio: José Hernández was an Argentine poet, journalist and politician, born in 1834 near Buenos Aires. He spent part of his youth in the countryside and later worked as a newspaper editor and served in public life; he died in Buenos Aires in 1886.

He is remembered above all for Martín Fierro, a narrative poem in the gauchesque tradition, published in 1872 as El gaucho Martín Fierro and continued in a second part in 1879. It gives a gaucho of the pampas a voice to tell of forced military service, injustice and outlawry, and it has long been regarded as Argentina's national poem.
